Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. Pakistan will breathe a bit easier while West Indies will want to prove that the win in the first ODI was not a fluke. The series is now leveled at 1-1 and the decider will be played on April 11, 2017 at 0930 local time (1330 GMT). We look forward to your company for that game. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed thanks the Almighty for the win. Admits that there is always pressure once you lose the first game. Praises Babar Azam for the way he anchored the innings and Imad Wasim for the way the finished it. Gives credit to the bowlers for scalping early wickets and putting the pressure on the hosts. Adds he doesn't try to yell at the young players but tries to mold them as this is an important series for Pakistan keeping the 2019 World Cup in mind. Further adds that they will put in their all in the series decider. On the wicket, he feels it didn't spin the other day but it did today and ends up saying it is getting slower day by day.

Man of the Match, Babar Azam thanks the Almighty at first. He says that he just wanted to bat through. Mentions that he and his skipper planned to bat deep and he would anchor the innings. On the wicket, he replies that he was looking to build partnerships. Says that he is happy to bat wherever the team wants and hopes to continue doing well.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder is disappointed with the loss today. Feels they conceded 20 runs more. Credits his team for playing so well. Admits his batters failed to fire today and adds had they did, they could have chased this down as the wicket was a good one to bat. Further says they need to be more consistent and emphasizes that the partnerships were the key which they couldn't get going. On his batting, he says he tries to stabilize the innings and is disappointed to have not helped his team cross the line. On the decider, he opines that they have done good things in both the games and hopes for a much better show in the final one.

Earlier in the day it was Babar Azam's brilliance that saw Pakistan post a par total. It was the 99-run stand between him and Imad Wasim that gave them the cushion and at the end it proved to be too many for the Windies. The best part about the win for the tourists was that everyone contributed to their success. Azam registered his career-best ODI score while Ali notched up his personal best with the ball in the 50-over format. The home side will be hurt with this loss. It has set up the series nicely though. Stay tuned for the details from the presentation.

Sarfraz Ahmed is pumping his fist and Hasan Ali is doing the Sajda! It has been a very vital win for the visitors. They dominated proceedings right from the word go. The new ball bowlers struck in time to peg the Windies back. The spinners then chipped in to reduce the home side to 75 for 6. Jason Holder and Ashley Nurse however shared an enterprising 58-run stand but they were just delaying the inevitable with the required run-rate creeping up all the while. Hasan Ali came back and his heroics ensured that Pakistan sealed the deal in time to keep the series alive.

OUT! Second 5-wicket haul for Hasan Ali in ODIs! Bowls it around off on a shorter length, Holder comes down the track to have a go at it. The ball goes off the toe end and skies up towards long off. Babar Azam, the fielder stationed there takes the catch easily and that is it for Pakistan. They have leveled the series with a huge 74-run win!
Full toss outside off by Hasan Ali, Holder is taken back and is late on his shot. The ball goes off the edge and flies on the bounce to the keeper.
Too full around off, Holder digs it out back to the bowler.
Too full outside off, squeezed towards backward point by Holder.
Shannon Gabriel is the new man in! Meanwhile, Amir is getting some treatment on his left shoulder.

Fuller on middle, pushed towards extra cover for a quick single.
Spears it full and wide outside off, Jospeh swings and misses. Amir is complaining about his shoulder to his captain now, who wants him to just bowl the final ball for now.
Holder eases one through mid on for a single.
50-run stand is up between Holder and Joseph!
Joseph digs out this fuller ball towards mid-wicket and takes off for a single. There is a shy at the non-striker's end but no harm done. Had he hit, would have been curtains for Alzarri.

Bowls it fuller on middle and leg, Holder shapes to smack it over covers but gets it off the outer half towards covers. It actually went off the pads.
Mohammad Amir returns.
Fuller outside off, driven wide of mid off for a couple of runs. This is now the highest stand for the ninth wicket for West Indies against Pakistan in ODIs.
Low full toss around off, Holder heaves it through square leg for a single.
Lands it outside off, Holder shapes to paddle but gets hit on his body. The ball goes to the right of the keeper who dives and stop the ball.
Fuller outside off, Holder slams it down to long on for a couple of runs. 200 up for West Indies. Sarfraz wants his deep fielders to get a lot straighter.
Jason drives this one nicely to mid off.

FOUR! More runs! Full outside off, Holder looks to give himself room and carve it through covers but gets an inside edge onto his back boot. The ball deflects down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Sarfraz Ahmed and Hasan Ali are not impressed.
Hasan Ali reintroduced into the attack.
This one is punched to covers by the batsman.
Lands it outside off, turns away, another push by the batsman, another miss.
Flatter outside off, Alzarri looks to cut it from his back foot but fails to defend it.
Flatter on middle and leg, turns in a touch, Joseph defends it watchfully.
Bowls it wide outside off, spins away miles, Joseph can do nothing about it.
Bowls it around off, the wrong 'un, Jospeh plays all over it but gets an inside edge onto his back leg.
Shorter in length, slower in pace, Holder pulls it through square leg. The fielder in the deep gets across and stops the ball. Two runs taken. West Indies need 88 more from 54 balls.
Spears in a length ball on the stumps, Joseph punches it towards mid on for a single. The bowler tries to stop it to his right but fails to do so.
Shorter outside off, Jospeh gets under it and pulls it over mid-wicket for a couple of runs. West Indies are fighting hard here.
Fuller outside off, Holder gets across and paddles this towards square leg for a single.
Angles it on a length, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.

Tossed up outside off, Holder punches it towards the man at covers.
Flatter one around middle, punched back to the bowler.
Goes forward and pushes it towards the off side.

A loud shout for a catch! Loopy delivery around off, Holder comes forward to drive but the ball turns away and beats the outside edge. Sarfraz behind the stumps takes it and appeals straightaway. Appeals long and hard but the umpire spots the daylight between bat and pad there.
Full around off, driven through covers by Alzarri to bring the skipper back on strike.
A googly around middle, defended off the back foot.
Shadab Khan called back on.

FOUR! Educated edge as one would say! Fuller in length and outside off, Holder looks to jam it out with his bat face open but gets an outside edge past the man at short third man. I like the way Holder stood after playing the shot, indicating that he's played that intentionally.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Too full on the pads, flicked down to short fine leg for a single.
3rd ODI fifty for Jason Holder!
FOUR! Fifty up for Jason Holder! Khan bowls a full toss outside off, too easy for Holder as he drills it through covers for a boundary. A raise of a bat from him, can he do it for his side?
SIX! That's outta here! Good length delivery, Holder shimmies down a bit and smashes it over mid-wicket for a 97m maximum. He makes it look so easy. West Indies need 106 from 70 balls.

A shout for a catch! Amir doles out a slower bumper on middle, Holder gets across to pull it away but is beaten by the lack of pace as the ball goes just past the gloves to the keeper who crouches low to take it. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Fuller in length and angling in, Holder gets across and flicks it through square leg for a single.

Now that is amusing! No one is keeping count of the balls in an over it seems. Sarfraz ran to the other end thinking it was over, Amir gets ready for the bowl too. They are too eager to get things done here, aren't they?
Fuller in length and around off, Jason looks to push it away but gets it off the outer part of the bat towards point.
Goes for the yorker but ends up slipping a low full toss on off, Holder drives it towards Shehzad at mid off.
Back of a length delivery outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Length ball, angling in, Joseph stays back and keeps it out.
Fuller outside off, Joseph defends it off the front foot.
Wide! Angles it down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone.
Junaid Khan called back on for a burst. There is a slight delay as there seems to be some issue with the ball. Yes, there is! A set of new balls is out.
On a length and outside off, Holder taps it towards point.
Stays back and defends it with his bat close to the pad.
Fuller in length and outside off, Joseph drives it on the up but just about evades the cover fielder for a single.
Good length delivery around off, Alzarri pushes it towards covers. Looks for a single but won't get it.
Angles in a length delivery, Joseph defends it down.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Mohammad Amir returns for a bowl.
Too full outside off, hit down to long off for a run. West Indies need 117 from 84 balls.
Drives it through covers for a single.
Lands it on middle, the wrong 'un, Joseph looks to drive but gets an inside edge to fine leg. Amir runs after it from short fine leg and stops it. Two runs taken.
Too full outside off, driven to cover-point.
Punched towards extra cover by the batsman.
Bowls it fuller outside off, Joseph looks to drive it away but is beaten.
Tossed up outside off, Jason drives it hard but once again finds the cover fielder.
Full around off, Holder mistimes his drive towards the cover fielder.
Jason makes room to go over covers but is beaten all ends up.
Holder gets down and paddles it down to fine leg for a double.
Tossed up around off, Holder looks to slog sweep but fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! A low full toss on the pads, Holder flicks it through mid-wicket with pure timing for a boundary.

OUT! Gone! Loopy leg spinner outside off, turning in sharply. Bishoo looks to work it off his back foot but misses it. The ball pings him on the front pad. A loud appeal from the players and it's upheld. That was dead plumb. Shadab is all pumped up!
FOUR! A loopy full toss around middle, Bishoo gets down and nails the sweep through backward square leg for a boundary.
Wrong 'un around off, Bishoo misses his attempted drive.
Loopy delivery outside off, turning in as Bishoo looks to cut it away but misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal is made but it's turned down.
Floated delivery around off, Holder lifts it down to long off and luckily the ball falls short of the man there.
Loopy leg spinner around off, turning away too much, Holder looks to push it away but gets beaten.
Drinks break!
Up and over the fielder! Fuller in length and outside off, Bishoo backs away and lifts it over covers. The fielder there leaps but the ball was way over him. A couple taken. 150 up for the Windies!
Comes down the track and wrists it down to long on for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Holder looks to smash it away but it mistimes it towards wide mid off.
Back of a length outside off, steered behind point for a comfortable one.
Angles in a length delivery, DB defends it by covering the line.
Short and cramping Bishoo for room whop chops it away towards covers.
Full around off, eased down to long off for one.
Bishoo comes forward to drive but this is again the wrong 'un and turns the other way to beat the batsman.
Googly served around off, Bishoo goes after it but gets beaten.
Holder goes back and turns it through mid-wicket for another single.
Loopy delivery around middle, Bishoo looks to flick but gets it off the inner half towards the leg side for a single.

Edged but doesn't carry! Fuller and outside off, Bishoo looks to go after it but gets an outside edge which falls short of the slip fielder.
Comes from around the wicket and fires it full on the stumps, Bishoo jams it out towards covers.
Good length, sprayed wide outside off, Bishoo throws the kitchen sink at it but gets beaten.
Pitches it up outside off, drilled through covers for a single.
This one is bowled short, expectedly, Holder cuts it to point for a single.

Ouch! Full toss around off, Bishoo clips it through mid-wicket. Hafeez in the deep gets around and fires a throw at the bowler's end. It is a wild one and Imad Wasim gets across, collects it and now he has a shy again. But to his horror, hit Shadab Khan on the hand. Shadab is really hurt and holding his spinning hand in pain. Three runs taken in the meanwhile.
Holder goes back and punches it to long off for a single.
Bowls it outside off, spins away beating the outstretched bat of Holder.
Floats it outside off, Holder looks to go over covers but misses.
Lands it on off and middle, Holder defends it.
Devendra Bishoo is the new man in.
More action! The umpire is having a word with the Pakistan players. Shoaib Malik has a word with the bowler, Hasan Ali and asks him to calm down.

OUT! No inside edge and Hasan Ali has the last laugh! Hurls it around off, the line Ali was looking to bowl. He gets it to come back in a touch, Nurse fails to clip it and is hit on his back leg and the players go up in a loud appeal. The umpire rules it out and the bowler erupts in joy. Nurse does not even consult Holder and takes the review. Replays show three reds and the vital stand is broken. Pakistan strike in time. Nurse has something to say even now. A review wasted. The crowd is stunned.
Ashley Nurse is adjudged LBW. It looks dead plumb but Nurse takes the review. Is there an inside edge?
Fuller outside off, Nurse drives it over cover-point for a couple of runs. The keeper is ensuring his bowlers are closing the game out and not leaving anything to chance.

FOUR! In the gap! Short around off, Nurse gets in line and pummels it through backward square leg for a boundary. This time Nurse has something to say to the bowler. This is now Nurse's highest score in ODI cricket!
Lands it outside off, Nurse looks to pull but is hit on his pads. There is a lot of stare and cussing happening out there.
50-run stand between Nurse and Holder!
FOUR! JUST WIDE! Outside off on a length, Nurse throws his bat at it. The ball flies past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
Length outside off, defended watchfully.
Hasan Ali called back on for a bowl.
Floats it outside off, driven through extra cover for a single.
Bowls it a touch closer to off and fuller, Nurse comes forward to defend but is beaten.
Sharp turn! Lands it outside off, spins away sharply, left alone by the batsman.
Another defensive push towards cover-point.
Lands it outside off, Nurse comes forward and defends it off the outer half towards the off side.
Drives it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! In the gap! Short again outside off, Nurse stays back and punches it through extra covers for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, Nurse goes back and looks to cut but misses.
Cuts it through point for a single.
Another push towards short extra cover.
Holder gets in position to reverse sweep but fails to connect cleanly.
Fuller outside off, Holder comes forward and drives it towards short extra cover.
FOUR! Hit away! Fuller outside off, Nurse gets across and clobbers it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Bowls it outside off, wider this time, Nurse looks to have a go but fails to put bat to ball.
SIX! Go, fetch that! Shadab bowls it around off and middle, Nurse gets under this  and clobbers it over wide long on for a maximum.
Lands it outside off, Nurse shapes to drive but is beaten all ends up.
Too full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
FOUR! In the gap! Fuller outside off, Nurse gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it wide of mid on for a boundary.
WIDE! Fires it down the leg side. Nurse shapes to heave it away but loses balance in the process. Luckily for him, no harm done.
Lands it on middle and off, Nurse sits down to sweep but the ball turns away and he is beaten all ends up.
Quicker one on off, Nurse keeps it out towards mid-wicket.

Flatter around off, Holder comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Nurse comes forward and drives it through the off side for a single.
Shorter in length, pulled to deep square leg for a single by Nurse. Just 2 runs from it.
Floats it outside off, left alone by Nurse.
Fuller on middle, Holder comes forward, opens the face of the bat and gets it towards covers for a single.
Shorter outside off, spins away a smile, Holder is beaten and lets it go at the end.
Lands it outside off, Holder shapes to drive it away but is beaten all ends up.
Flatter on middle and leg, Holder goes back to work it through mid-wicket but gets hit on his pads.
Nurse punches one through covers for a couple of runs.
Shorter outside off, chopped towards third man for a single.
Holder gets in line and defends it.
Just short! Lands it outside off, Holder pushes it on the bounce towards short extra cover.
Another one pushed into covers.
Holder comes forward and drives it towards covers.
FOUR! In the gap! Flatter on middle, Nurse gets down on one knee and sweeps it between the short fine leg and square leg fielders for a boundary.
Lands it outside off, spins away sharply, Nurse is beaten all ends up. That was a normal leg spinner.
Sweeps it through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Nurse gets in line and defends it.

NOT OUT! Lands it on middle, Nurse comes forward to defend but is rapped on his back leg. The ball flies towards first slip who takes the catch and appeals as well. The umpire though has given it out lbw. The players celebrate but the two batsmen are having a chat. They opt for a review. Replays show the ball pitched in line, impact was in line too but the ball was spinning down the leg side and hence Nurse survives!
Nurse is given out LBW but he takes the review straightaway. Is there an inside edge?
Shorter outside off, Nurse goes back to punch it towards covers.
Shadab Khan called on for a bowl.
Eases one down to long on for a single.
A touch quicker on the stumps, Nurse defends it with his bat and pad together. An appeal for an lbw is turned down. Think there was a bit of bat there.
Nurse comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Flat around off, pushed towards covers by Nurse.
Flatter on middle and leg, Nurse comes forward and turns it towards the leg side.
Shorter outside off, Nurse mistimes his punch towards covers.
FOUR! Spanked! Short and flat on the stumps, Holder makes room and punches it through covers. Splits the gap there and finds the fence.
Darted on the stumps, worked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Fires it around middle, turned towards the leg side.
Tossed up on the stumps, Holder bunts it back to the bowler.
Slider around middle, swept to fine leg for one.
Tossed up around middle and off, Holder comes forward and looks to wrist it down but gets an inside edge towards square leg. A single taken.
Quicker full ball around off, driven towards covers for another single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full around off, milked down to long on by Holder for one.

Tossed up around off, defended into the ground.
Full around middle, Ashley closes the face of the bat early and ends up getting a safe leading edge back to the bowler.

On middle and leg, Nurse drives it to long on for a single.
Ashley Nurse walks in next, replacing Carter!

It's always a risky stroke to play because if you don't connect, you will most likely end up in trouble. Hafeez appeals and the umpire has no harm in raising his finger. Carter walks down and asks his skipper about the review. Holder says no and Carter starts to trudge. Replays show it would have missed the off stump. West Indies slip further.

Floats it up around off, defends it by prodding forward.
Flatter through the air around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Lunges forward and defends it towards the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up outside off, Holder lunges forward and drives it to long off for a single.
Comes forward and defends it off the front foot.
Darted around middle, swept towards fine leg for one.
Tossed up outside off, Holder drives it towards long off for a single.
Imad Wasim comes on for a bowl.
That was a bit risky! An arm ball around middle, Carter brings his bat and pad together in defense and luckily he got an inside edge there.
Tossed up outside off, knocked down to long on got a single.
Flighted delivery around off, defended off the front foot.
Floats it up outside off, Carter goes back to defend but gets an outside edge behind point for one.
Tossed up around middle, flicked through mid on for a single.
Low full toss on middle, eased down to long on for one.
Fuller again outside off, Holder drives it again through the same region but this time there is protection. A couple taken. Good intent from the skipper!

Shuffles a bit and tucks it towards the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, defended towards the cover region.
Full around middle, Holder looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards mid off for a single.
Jason Holder is the new man in!
Drinks taken!

OUT! Sarfraz Ahmed has taken a superb catch here! Hafeez slides it around leg, Jason Mohammed gets down to sweep but seems to be early into the shot. The ball goes off the gloves behind and Sarfraz Ahmed is very alert about this. He turns back quickly and dives full length to grab a terrific one-handed catch. They appeal and the umpire raises his finger. West Indies have lost half their side here and look in all sorts of trouble.
Darts it around middle, worked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Floats it up around middle and leg, Mohammed gets back to flick but is hit on the pads.
Full around middle, defended towards the leg side.
Tossed up around middle, defended by covering the line.
Touch fuller and outside off, Carter pushes it towards the cover fielder.
Comes from around the wicket and keeps it full on the stumps. The batsman jams it out towards backward point.

A length ball outside off, Mohammed defends it off the back foot.
Good length delivery on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
In the corridor outside off, Mohammed shoulders his arms.
Carter gets down and paddles it fine down the leg side for a couple.
JC prods forward and blocks it out.

A stifled appeal for an LBW! Hafeez bowls a slider around middle and leg, Mohammed gets down and across to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads as the ball rolls down towards fine leg. Hafeez appeals but it was going down leg. They take a leg bye.
Mohammed presses forward and defends it down.
Slider around middle, flicked towards short fine leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, patted back to the bowler.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Another loud shout but it's turned down yet again! Fuller and angling in from outside off, Mohammed misses it once again and is hit on the back leg once more. A loud appeal is turned down as the impact was outside the line again. Hasan Ali is bowling superbly here!

NOT OUT! The decision stays! Just when we praised Pakistan for being bang on with their reviews today, they have wasted it now! Hasan Ali comes from over the wicket and angles it in from outside off, Mohammed comes forward to defend but is beaten and struck on the back pad. The players appeal long and hard but the umpire isn't interested. They take the review and replays show that the impact was well outside off. So, the on-field decision stands!
Another lbw appeal not given in favour of the bowler. Hasan Ali wants it reviewed.

OUT! The decision is overturned! Pakistan have got both their reviews bang on today! First one was of Imad Wasim while they were batting and now this. West Indies are going nowhere here. Hasan Ali comes from around the wicket and angles in a length delivery on middle. Powell looks to flick it across the line but misses and is rapped on the pads. The players appeal but umpire Ian Gould turns it down. Ali convinces his skipper to opt for the review. Replays show there is no bat involved. Next thing, it's in line and going onto hit the middle stump. Powell has to walk back, West Indies in deep trouble.
Review time! Powell is struck on his pads and Pakistan are confident that he is out. Hasan Ali convinces Sarfraz Ahmed to go for the review.

Shorter in length on the stumps, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Around off, Powell mistimes his drive towards mid on.
Nudged towards mid-wicket by the batsman.

OUT! Gone! Walton's misery continues! Junaid Khan hurls a length delivery on middle, Chadwick opts for the pull from outside off but gets a top edge instead. The ball lobs in the air towards the leg side and Hasan Ali from mid on moves to his right, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes it safely. Good catch and Pakistan get a breakthrough.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards the off side.
Good length delivery, angling in, Lewis defends it back down the wicket.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, Evin clips it to deep square leg for a comfortable couple.
FOUR! Lewis is in T20 mode it seems! Gets a genuine half-volley and he dispatches it over extra cover. One bounce and into the fence she goes.
Back of a length ball on middle, defended down on the off side.
FOUR! Flayed! Short and outside off, Lewis gets on the top of the bounce and cuts it past the point fielder for a boundary. Stand and deliver stuff!

FOUR! Deliberately done? Maybe! In the channel outside off, Walton looks to withdraw the bat at the last moment but was a bit too late. The ball hits the bat and evades the only slip fielder for a boundary down to third man.
Back of a length ball on middle, Walton pulls it through backward square leg for a couple.
Good length on middle, defended back to the bowler.
FOUR! This is rubbing salt on the wound! Fuller in length and outside off, Walton chips it over the infield. It races away to the fence for a boundary.

In the air... dropped! It can't get any easier than this! Touch fuller and just around off, Lewis prods forward to drive it on the up but ends up chipping it towards extra cover where the substitute fielder Fakhar Zaman dives to his left to take it but the ball bursts out of his hands. They take a single as well. Junaid Khan is disappointed and rightly so.
On a length and serving it just around off, pushed off the back foot towards the off side.
Junaid Khan to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Good length delivery on off, defended towards the point fielder. A good start to the over!
Slightly short on middle and off, defended with a straight bat towards covers.
Angles it away, on a length, Walton defends it firmly towards the off side.
Length ball, curling back in from around off, Walton looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Good length delivery, shaping away a touch, Lewis is opened up a touch but still hangs his bat out. Gets an outside edge down to third man for a single.
Starts off with a good length ball outside off, punched towards covers.
Welcome back for the chase! The two openers for West Indies are Chadwick Walton and Evin Lewis. Mohammad Amir to bowl with the first new ball.
